title: Parity-separated inverse-factorial resurgence of incomplete-gamma transition coefficients
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof controls a convolution of transition coefficients and resurgent reciprocal-gamma coefficients uniformly in a complex parameter. It also isolates the parity-dependent leading terms and establishes quantitative remainder bounds for the self-reproducing inverse-factorial expansions.
author: Gergő Nemes
